# Group fill native reference

Original OPC/XML generated by tools/canvas_group_fill_fixture.py from our own
fixture package. Twelve groups compare explicit grpFill, child solid/noFill,
absent child fill, nested absent/grpFill/solid/noFill, root absent/noFill, and
explicit child overrides within nested groups. No user artwork is included.

The exact fixture was opened in the reference application and exported without saving.
reference.json records the source hash and 36 RGB samples extracted from
native.pdf by tools/group_fills_reference.py. Browser checks compare all
samples after import, text edit, export/reopen and undo. Complete group XML is
retained and every ZIP entry is restored after undo.

Part 1 section 20.1.8.35 specifies group-fill inheritance. Reference compatibility
observation: a nested group's explicit noFill does not stop its grpFill child's
lookup of an enclosing solid group fill. Case 8 proves this independently;
case 3 confirms that a shape's own noFill still paints nothing. This behavior
is implemented without rewriting either group's or child's XML.
